name: continuous-tabs
title: Continuous tabs
description: Tabs where a pill slides to the one you pick, with arrow keys like a proper tab list.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Tab that is active at the start when the tabs are not controlled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the tab id each time the active tab changes, by click or arrow key.

props.name: label
props.description: Read aloud for the whole row, e.g. "Sections".

props.name: id
props.description: Base for the tab and panel ids. Tab buttons get `<id>-tab-<tab id>` and the built-in panel `<id>-panel-<tab id>`; a generated id is used when left out.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders the content of the active tab inside a built-in tabpanel that is wired to its tab.

a11y.text: The row has one Tab stop, on the active tab. ArrowRight and ArrowLeft wrap around, Home and End jump to the ends, and the tab that receives focus is selected at once. The built-in panel is focusable.

The row is a tablist named by label, which is required. Each tab is a button with role tab, an id and aria-selected. With a children function, the active tab gets aria-controls pointing to a built-in tabpanel that is labelled by that tab. Without it, a tab's panelId becomes its aria-controls.
The component is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user, so Motion follows the system setting for the sliding pill. The colour transition is off under reduced motion.
